'''In-game description: '''<br />''Prove your loyalty and dedication to the factions by completing their unique Challenges. You will be rewarded with new perks and upgrades to help in your Realm Grinder progress!''

'''All challenges need that faction.'''

'''All challenge 2 need that faction and that bloodline.'''

[[File:ChallengesComplete.PNG|right|259x259px]]
'''Challenges''' were first implemented in v1.4, [[Patch Notes|''The Secret of the Realms'']] expansion, bringing new perks to the [[Vanilla]] Factions. More challenges<ref>''The Neutral challenges were added in [[Patch Notes|patch]] v1.5.45;  the Prestige in v.1.6.52; and Dragon in v2.5.0.0''</ref> were added as new factions appeared. As of v2.5, there are now a total of 46 tier challenges, and 58 rewards<ref>''There are in total 46 tier challenges, and 58 rewards: 3x6 for Vanilla Factions; 4x3 Neutral; 16 Prestige; and the 12 final rewards.''</ref>.

Upon reaching R2, a "Challenge" tab will appear, there you can see a list of all the available challenges with their [[#Requirements by Tier|unlock requirements]]. There are several Tier challenges for each faction. They can only be completed in order of tier, as each require the previous one be completed, but you can accomplish multiple tiers on a same run. - You just cannot get later Tiers before earlier Tiers.

Each tier challenge rewards a perk, and completing all the tier challenges of a Faction will reward a [[Challenges#Final Challenge Rewards|spell upgrade]].

All challenge rewards<ref>''Looking at the tier challenge rewards, you can notice patterns such as:<br />The first tier upgrades boost their own faction.<br>The last tier upgrades are always universal upgrades. <br />Tier 2 and 3 upgrades boost an other Faction of the same Vanilla, Neutral, or Prestige alignment.<br />Dwarf & Drow tier 2 and 3 boost a Vanilla faction of the same Good or Evil alignment.<br />All Prestige faction tiers boost their own faction. <br />Etc. - See [[Tier challenge rewards|sortable table of Tier Challenge rewards]].''</ref> are free, and after the [[Spells#Spell Upgrades|faction spell upgrade]] has been purchased, will be turned on by default. When they are active (!)<ref>''You must play the faction in question to get the perk active, and be able to turn it on and off again.''</ref>, they can be toggled on and off by clicking on their respective icons, and will remain through soft-resets until turned on again.

Once a challenge has been completed, the perk will be available whenever you are playing as the faction corresponding to the ''background ''of that challenge. For example, Demons benefit from Demon Challenge 1, but also Goblin Challenge 2, and do not benefit from Demon Challenge 2 (which lacks the red/black background).

== Tips ==
This section provides tips, hints and potentially spoilers on how to complete the various challenges.

{| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed wikitable" style="width:100%;"
!Tier 1 Hints
|-
|
*'''Elf 1:''' You can use [[excavations]].
*'''Fairy 1:''' Do excavations to quickly get the Fairy Heritage upgrade. Don't forget the Fairy Choir spell upgrade.
*'''Angel 1''': Recommended +1 B (1<sub>E</sub>9) gems. <s>You will need a min mana regen of 60 m/s</s> to get enough Holy Light casts. Avoid purchasing Angelic Dominance (3,2). If you have [[bloodlines]] (R7), choose the Druid Bloodline. — "Daytime" is considered to be from 6 AM to 6 PM on your system clock. ([[Challenges#comm-9383|source]])
*'''Undead 1:''' Requires at least 11h, 6m, 40s playtime, and there are no perks that could reduce it. You also need to have the True Night spell upgrade, but you do not need the Undead heritage, nor have it unlocked. It is easier to do this at R16 along with unlocking time-gated [[research]] D25.
*'''Goblin 1:''' While Green Fingers Discount says it works offline, it does not work in the same way as online, and this challenge cannot be completed offline or when coming online based on the offline effect of GFD. The challenge can be attempted in multiple tabs simultaneously, but GFD randomness is decided when the upgrade is bought, and if you are using multiple tabs, be sure to import / load the save before buying the upgrade.
*'''Demon 1:''' Ruby power, scrying, and challenge rewards are allowed. It is easier to do this at R7+ using the Elven [[bloodline]].
*'''Titan 1:''' Since RG v2, this can be done solely with building assistants (You get 1 assistant for each 5th and 25th building upgrades). Avoid Reincarnation power, Undead & Drow bloodline, and Undead 3 challenge. By precaution, don't even get the other assistant upgrades. At lower Rs, it is easier to do it with the minimum required 13 assistants. Check your [[stats]] regularly and when you get close to the required 169 total [[RE]]s, switch to buying them one by one - careful to not over-buy! Remember you can have more than 13 assistants so long as you have the required multiple of 13*(#assistants) REs. (eg.: 26 assistants => 338 RE)
**Note that it requires 13*(#assistants) total, not 13*(#assistants) for each faction. For example, if you had 13 assistants, you would need 169 exchanges total, not 169 Fairy exchanges + 169 Elven exchanges etc etc.
**Using Ruby Power if you have bought bonus Assistants will cause the challenge to bug out and become impossible to complete.
{| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed wikitable" style="width:80%;"
! colspan="8" |Assistants to REs
|-
!13!!14!!15!!16!!17!!18!!19!!20
|-
|169||182||195||208||221||234||247||260
|}
*'''Druid 1:''' Make sure your least-producing building still makes up a large proportion of your production (2% and up). This will necessarily balance the production of each of your other buildings around 9.09% (= 1/11). Upgrade buildings only when you need to balance them. Building more Farms, Inns and Blacksmiths will increase the multiplier of the final Grand Balance cast.
*'''Faceless 1:''' ?''
|}

{| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed wikitable" style="width:100%;"
! Tier 2 Hints
|-
|
*'''Fairy 2:''' Don't forget to purchase the Bloodline within the time limit.
*'''Elf 2:''' Autocast Moon Blessing and pick Elven Bloodline and this will complete in ~55 minutes if you have the mana to sustain it (35/sec).
*'''Angel 2:''' You have to use the Angel faction with the Angel bloodline (Merc won't work because of the requirements). Use bronze autocast for all spells. Dwarven Pickaxe is another spell, so make sure to get it. If you have R16 with Spiritual Surge, this will take ~55 minutes. Avoid buying Angelic Wisdom and Angelic Dominance: shorter and more costly spells mean more mana used and thus, more mana produced (Mana production only count when filling the mana bar, exceeding amount are not accounted).
*'''Demon 2:''' High gem and low Excavations (relative). Work up enough coins to excavate 95 <abbr title="Royal Exchanges">REs</abbr>, and then buy 1 or 2 more to get exactly 666. Do not buy any Demon exchanges. Drow's blackmail upgrade helps the challenge, and the exchanges don't have to be spread evenly.
*'''Titan 2:''' This challenge does not need to be done within one spell combo. In addition, due to a bug, it counts one click per second if you have at least one assistant. It's possible to meet the condition without clicking at all: while spells are active cast 3 spells that last 20 seconds together 4 times.
*'''Dwarf 2: '''To complete this at the end of R11, you need a lot of Faction Coins. If you have already excavated a lot, wait for the end of the next reincarnate, keep excavations low this time. Get Dwarf bloodline, Fairy faction, then excavate, buy all heritages and exchanges. Alternate between maxing buildings and upgrades. Cast a Fairy Chanting + Call to Arms combo right before the two minute limit. Don't forget Dwarven trade treaty!
**See [https://steamcommunity.com/app/610080/discussions/0/1474222595310117457/#c1474222595310251473 this post] on the Steam forums for a step-by-step guide
*'''Dragon 2:''' As for the reward's spell tier reduction, the formula implemented in the game is: ''<code>max(0,(1 - (x / 28)<sup>9</sup>)), where x is GB time in days</code>. ''The cost of tiers are multiplied by it, so if it yields 0.1, that's a 90% reduction. Here's a [http://www.wolframalpha.com/input/?i=log+plot+(1+-+x%2F28)%5E9,+x+%3D+0+to+28 plot] of the function. It goes from 0% reduction to 100% reduction over the course of 28 days of GB time. (Source: [[Challenges#comm-9841|Comment reply by Pseudobyte]])
|}

{| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed wikitable" style="width:100%;"
! Tier 3 Hints
|-
|
*'''Tier 3:''' Except for the Fairy Challenge, they can easily be done with 1 Qivg (1e78) gems (or less for Demon).
*'''Fairy 3:''' Use Goblin Bloodline.
*'''Demon 3:''' Use Goblin Bloodline, can be easily done around Uvg gems.
*'''Titan 3:''' Use Faceless Bloodline. For 80 TC and one LS, 80*200 + 600 = 16600 Mana are needed.
*'''Druid 3:''' Now that Grand Balance affects 0 buildings, it will target the next building down the list:
*#Buy Max Farms, Max Inns, Max Blacksmiths, and Max Deep Mines. > Cast Grand Balance
*#Buy Max Stone Pillars and Max Alchy Labs > Cast Grand Balance
*#Buy Max Monasteries, Max Labys, and Max Iron Strongholds > Cast Grand Balance.
*'''Dwarf 3:''' Use the Elf bloodline and this is pretty much automatic.
|}

{| class="mw-collapsible mw-collapsed wikitable" style="width:100%;"
! Tier 4+ Hints
|-
|
*'''Neutral Tier 4:''' While it's ''possible'' to get the neutral unique buildings and complete the requirements for the tier 4 challenges, you need to be R25 for them to be awarded.
*'''Druid 4:''' You need at least 50 m/s, and to start [[autocasting]] GB within approximately 59 seconds of game start, as you are only required to <u>start</u> the 13th cast within the time limit, not finish it. Take Druid bloodline, remember not to buy Halls of Balance, and it should be trivial. If you cast manually instead of autocasting, you can shave off a couple of seconds total, as autocasting takes a whole second to cast again after a spell runs out. Can also be done with Elven bloodline: Abdicate, Pick Elven Bloodline, Buy all, Neutral faction, Buy all, Pick druid faction. Cast first GB. Don't forget to buy buildings in between. Don't buy HoB, but purchase heritages and upgrades individually. With elven bloodline you can cast the first GB much faster and you can purchase druid upgrades and heritages faster, which gets you close to 50 m/s, which is enough.
*'''Faceless 4:''' This is the equivalent of about 8.5 days of time spent allied with Faceless. Getting the Titan Tier 2 challenge ''Harmony of Thoughts'' will help increase your Faceless playtime.
*'''Titan 4:''' Buy Olympian Halls, generate as much mana per second from non-Research methods (mostly Heritages), set Lightning Strike on bronze (Ctrl+Shift) - Then wait. On average, it takes 132** strikes to get the two-in-a-row strikes. The[[Tools| Realm Weather Service tool]] can help forecast strikes.<br /><nowiki>**</nowiki> <small>The theoretical average is 132, my experimental average was more like 135, which may be due to the small statespace of the PRNG used by Realm Grinder. It is true that the odds of any two particular strikes both being on Olympian Halls are 1/121. That does not imply that it takes 121 casts on average because the pairs of casts are not statistically independent. At 20 seconds per cast, using Druid bloodline to have LS cast immediately after finishing, and averaging 132 casts, this challenge may only take approximately 44 minutes.</small>
*'''Dragon challenges''' : general [http://www.kongregate.com/forums/8945-realm-grinder/topics/696468-challenge-5-6-a-small-guide#posts-10944089 advice] by artcrow
*'''Dragon 4:''' Suggested Faction to use is Faceless ([http://www.kongregate.com/forums/8945-realm-grinder/topics/691840-dragon-chal-4?page=3#posts-10915939 build] by artcrow: [http://www.kongregate.com/forums/8945-realm-grinder/topics/676749-dragon-builds?page=13#posts-10914734 build] by eatnsleep)
|}
